notes: Giữ nguyên 7 ngày và số lượng câu hỏi theo curriculum người dùng cung cấp.
Mỗi chủ điểm có định nghĩa, công thức, cách dùng, tín hiệu, ví dụ dịch nghĩa, lỗi thường gặp và so sánh.
Ngân hàng câu hỏi có kèm đáp án và giải thích để dùng cho chế độ chấm bài. Nếu triển khai bài kiểm tra cho người học, ẩn correct_answer và explanation cho đến khi nộp bài.

days.title: Tenses
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Present Simple
topics.definition: Diễn tả thói quen, sự thật, trạng thái tương đối ổn định và lịch trình cố định.
topics.formula: S + V(s/es); S + do/does not + V; Do/Does + S + V?; S + am/is/are (+ not).
topics.usage: Daily routines, general truths, permanent situations, timetables.

examples.en: She works from Monday to Friday.
examples.vi: Cô ấy làm việc từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu.

common_mistakes: He work here → He works here.
topics.comparison: Present Continuous: thói quen/ổn định đối lập với hành động đang diễn ra/tạm thời.

topics.name: Present Continuous
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra, tình huống tạm thời, sự thay đổi hoặc kế hoạch đã sắp xếp.
topics.formula: S + am/is/are + V-ing; S + am/is/are not + V-ing; Am/Is/Are + S + V-ing?
topics.usage: Actions happening now, temporary situations, changing situations, arranged future plans.

examples.en: I am studying English at the moment.
examples.vi: Tôi đang học tiếng Anh lúc này.

common_mistakes: I am work → I am working.
topics.comparison: Present Simple: thói quen hoặc sự thật; một số stative verbs thường không dùng tiếp diễn.

topics.name: Past Simple
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động hoặc trạng thái đã xảy ra và kết thúc trong quá khứ.
topics.formula: S + V2/ed; S + did not + V; Did + S + V?; was/were (với BE).
topics.usage: Completed past actions, past habits, a sequence of past events.

examples.en: We visited Thailand last year.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đã thăm Thái Lan năm ngoái.

common_mistakes: Did you went? → Did you go?
topics.comparison: Present Perfect: quá khứ đơn có thời điểm đã kết thúc; Present Perfect nhấn liên hệ hiện tại.

topics.name: Past Continuous
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ hoặc làm bối cảnh cho hành động khác.
topics.formula: S + was/were + V-ing; S + was/were not + V-ing; Was/Were + S + V-ing?
topics.usage: An action in progress at a past time; background action interrupted by another event; two simultaneous actions.

examples.en: I was watching TV when my friend called.
examples.vi: Tôi đang xem TV thì bạn tôi gọi.

common_mistakes: I was watch TV → I was watching TV.
topics.comparison: Past Simple: sự kiện hoàn tất; Past Continuous: hành động đang diễn ra làm nền.

topics.name: Present Perfect
topics.definition: Diễn tả trải nghiệm, kết quả hiện tại, hành động vừa xảy ra hoặc tình huống bắt đầu trong quá khứ còn liên quan hiện tại.
topics.formula: S + have/has + V3; S + have/has not + V3; Have/Has + S + V3?
topics.usage: Life experiences, present result, recent events, unfinished time periods, states continuing to now.

examples.en: I have visited Thailand twice.
examples.vi: Tôi đã đến Thái Lan hai lần.

common_mistakes: I have seen him yesterday → I saw him yesterday.
topics.comparison: Past Simple dùng với mốc quá khứ đã kết thúc; Present Perfect không thường đi với yesterday/last year.

topics.name: Present Perfect Continuous
topics.name_vi: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn
topics.definition: Nhấn mạnh quá trình hoặc khoảng thời gian của hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và còn tiếp diễn hoặc vừa mới kết thúc.
topics.formula: S + have/has been + V-ing; S + have/has not been + V-ing; Have/Has + S + been + V-ing?
topics.usage: Emphasises duration, ongoing activity, or visible recent activity.

examples.en: She has been learning English for six months.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã học tiếng Anh được sáu tháng.

common_mistakes: She has learning → She has been learning.
topics.comparison: Present Perfect thường nhấn kết quả/số lượng; dạng Continuous nhấn quá trình/thời lượng.

topics.name: Past Perfect
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động xảy ra trước một hành động hoặc thời điểm khác trong quá khứ.
topics.formula: S + had + V3; S + had not + V3; Had + S + V3?
topics.usage: An earlier past action before another past event or past reference time.

examples.en: The train had left before we arrived.
examples.vi: Tàu đã rời đi trước khi chúng tôi đến.

common_mistakes: When I arrived, he has left → he had left.
topics.comparison: Past Simple kể sự kiện quá khứ; Past Perfect làm rõ sự kiện xảy ra trước.

topics.name: Future Simple
topics.definition: Diễn tả quyết định tức thời, dự đoán, lời hứa, đề nghị hoặc sự kiện tương lai.
topics.formula: S + will + V; S + will not + V; Will + S + V?
topics.usage: Instant decisions, predictions, promises, offers, future facts.

examples.en: I will help you with the report.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ giúp bạn làm báo cáo.

common_mistakes: I will to call → I will call.
topics.comparison: Be going to thường diễn tả dự định đã có hoặc dự đoán có bằng chứng.

topics.name: Be going to
topics.definition: Diễn tả dự định đã có trước thời điểm nói hoặc dự đoán dựa trên dấu hiệu hiện tại.
topics.formula: S + am/is/are going to + V; S + am/is/are not going to + V; Am/Is/Are + S + going to + V?
topics.usage: Prior plans and evidence-based predictions.

examples.en: Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.
examples.vi: Nhìn những đám mây kia kìa. Trời sắp mưa.

common_mistakes: She going to travel → She is going to travel.
topics.comparison: Will thường là quyết định tức thời/dự đoán chung; going to là dự định trước hoặc có bằng chứng.

topics.name: Future Continuous
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động sẽ đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm cụ thể trong tương lai.
topics.formula: S + will be + V-ing; S + will not be + V-ing; Will + S + be + V-ing?
topics.usage: An action in progress at a specified future time; polite enquiries about plans.

examples.en: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Singapore.
examples.vi: Giờ này ngày mai, tôi sẽ đang bay đến Singapore.

common_mistakes: I will be work → I will be working.
topics.comparison: Future Simple nói hành động/sự kiện; Future Continuous nhấn quá trình tại một thời điểm tương lai.

topics.name: Tense Contrast
topics.definition: Chọn thì theo mốc thời gian, trạng thái hoàn tất, quá trình và quan hệ giữa các sự kiện.
topics.formula: Xác định: when? (mốc thời gian), finished? (đã kết thúc), duration? (thời lượng), before/after? (trình tự).
topics.usage: Contrast the main tense pairs in meaningful contexts.

examples.en: I have worked here for two years, but I worked in Hanoi before that.
examples.vi: Tôi đã làm ở đây hai năm, nhưng trước đó tôi làm việc ở Hà Nội.

common_mistakes: Chọn thì chỉ dựa vào một từ khóa mà bỏ qua ngữ cảnh.
topics.comparison: So sánh cả thời điểm nói, mốc thời gian và ý nghĩa người nói muốn nhấn mạnh.

questions.question: My colleague _____ the weekly report every Friday.
questions.explanation: He/she/it + V-s.

questions.question: _____ your team use TypeScript?
questions.explanation: Your team is treated as plural here; use Do + subject + base verb.

questions.question: She doesn't _____ coffee after 6 p.m.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base verb.

questions.question: Please be quiet. The baby _____.
questions.explanation: An action happening now uses am/is/are + V-ing.

questions.question: I _____ with my cousin this week while my apartment is repaired.
questions.explanation: A temporary situation around now uses Present Continuous.

questions.question: Why _____ you _____ at your phone? The meeting is starting.
questions.explanation: Use the present continuous for an action happening now.

questions.question: We _____ the client yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday is a finished past time; use Past Simple.

questions.question: She _____ her first job in 2022.
questions.explanation: A specific finished time in the past takes Past Simple.

questions.question: Did they _____ the email last night?
questions.explanation: After did, use the base verb.

questions.question: At 9 p.m. last night, I _____ for my exam.
questions.explanation: An action in progress at a specific past time uses was/were + V-ing.

questions.question: I was cooking when the phone _____.
questions.explanation: The longer background action is Past Continuous; the interrupting event is Past Simple.

questions.question: While we _____, it started to rain.
questions.explanation: While commonly introduces an action in progress in the past.

questions.question: I _____ that film three times.
questions.explanation: Life experience without a finished time uses Present Perfect.

questions.question: She _____ her homework, so she can relax now.
questions.explanation: The completed action has a result in the present.

questions.question: We _____ here since 2021.
questions.explanation: Since + starting point with a continuing situation commonly takes Present Perfect.

questions.question: Have you _____ tried sushi?
questions.explanation: Ever is common in Present Perfect questions about experience.

questions.question: He _____ for two hours, and he is still working.
questions.explanation: Emphasis is on the ongoing activity and its duration.

questions.question: Your clothes are wet. _____ you _____ in the rain?
questions.explanation: A recent activity with visible present evidence can use Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: By the time we arrived, the film _____.
questions.explanation: The film started before another past event; use Past Perfect.

questions.question: She couldn't open the file because she _____ the password.
questions.explanation: Forgetting happened before the later past situation.

questions.question: The phone is ringing. I _____ it.
questions.explanation: A decision made at the moment of speaking uses will.

questions.question: I promise I _____ your secret.
questions.explanation: Will is used for promises.

questions.question: Look at the dark clouds. It _____.
questions.explanation: Evidence now supports a prediction with be going to.

questions.question: We _____ a new laptop next month; we've already chosen the model.
questions.explanation: A prior plan/intention uses be going to.

questions.question: This time tomorrow, we _____ to Hanoi.
questions.explanation: An action in progress at a specified future time uses will be + V-ing.

questions.question: At 10 a.m. tomorrow, _____ you _____ the presentation?
questions.explanation: Future Continuous forms questions with will + subject + be + V-ing.

questions.question: I _____ him last Monday, but I _____ him since then.
questions.explanation: Last Monday is finished; since then connects the period to now.

questions.question: When I got home, my family _____ dinner.
questions.explanation: Eating happened before I got home.

questions.question: She _____ English for three years and still studies every day.
questions.explanation: The duration continues to now and emphasizes the learning process.

questions.question: I think our team _____ the match, but we need to practise.
questions.explanation: A prediction/opinion with I think commonly uses will.

days.title: Verb Forms & Modal Verbs
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Gerunds (V-ing)
topics.definition: V-ing có chức năng như danh từ, thường đứng sau một số động từ, giới từ hoặc làm chủ ngữ.
topics.formula: Verb + V-ing; Preposition + V-ing; V-ing + verb (as subject).
topics.usage: After verbs such as enjoy, avoid, finish; after prepositions; as subject.

examples.en: I enjoy playing badminton.
examples.vi: Tôi thích chơi cầu lông.

common_mistakes: I enjoy to play → I enjoy playing.
topics.comparison: Infinitive follows verbs such as want, decide, hope.

topics.name: Infinitives (to + V)
topics.name_vi: Động từ nguyên mẫu có to
topics.definition: Dùng sau một số động từ, tính từ hoặc để diễn tả mục đích.
topics.formula: Verb + to V; adjective + to V; to V (purpose).
topics.usage: After want, decide, hope, plan, need; after adjectives; to express purpose.

examples.en: She decided to study abroad.
examples.vi: Cô ấy quyết định đi du học.

common_mistakes: She decided studying → She decided to study.
topics.comparison: Một số động từ theo sau bởi V-ing, một số theo sau bởi to V; cần học theo verb pattern.

topics.name: Bare Infinitives
topics.name_vi: Động từ nguyên mẫu không to
topics.definition: Dùng sau modal verbs và một số động từ đặc biệt như make/let trong cấu trúc chủ động.
topics.formula: Modal + V; make/let + object + V; help + object + (to) V.
topics.usage: After can, must, should, will; make/let someone do something.

examples.en: My manager let me leave early.
examples.vi: Quản lý cho phép tôi về sớm.

common_mistakes: Let me to go → Let me go.
topics.comparison: Ở thể bị động với make: be made to do.

topics.name: Verb Patterns
topics.definition: Một số động từ đi với V-ing, một số đi với to V, object + to V hoặc object + bare V.
topics.formula: Verb + V-ing / to V / object + to V / object + bare V.
topics.usage: Choose the complement required by the main verb.

examples.en: They asked me to check the document.
examples.vi: Họ yêu cầu tôi kiểm tra tài liệu.

common_mistakes: They suggested me to go → They suggested going / suggested that I go.
topics.comparison: Stop/remember/try có thể đổi nghĩa tùy V-ing hay to V.

topics.name: Can / Could / Be able to
topics.name_vi: Khả năng và sự cho phép
topics.definition: Can/could diễn tả khả năng, yêu cầu hoặc sự cho phép; be able to linh hoạt theo nhiều thì.
topics.formula: S + can/could + V; S + be able to + V; modal + not + V; modal + S + V?
topics.usage: Ability, permission, requests, general and specific ability.

examples.en: I can solve this problem, but I couldn't solve it yesterday.
examples.vi: Tôi có thể giải quyết vấn đề này, nhưng hôm qua tôi đã không thể.

common_mistakes: She can to swim → She can swim.
topics.comparison: Be able to dùng được ở dạng tương lai/hoàn thành; could thường nói khả năng chung trong quá khứ.

topics.name: Must / Have to / Need to
topics.name_vi: Sự bắt buộc và cần thiết
topics.definition: Diễn tả nghĩa vụ hoặc sự cần thiết; must thường thể hiện quan điểm/nghĩa vụ mạnh của người nói, have to thường do quy định/hoàn cảnh.
topics.formula: must + V; have/has to + V; need/needs to + V; don't/doesn't have to + V.
topics.usage: Obligation, rules, necessity.

examples.en: Employees have to wear an ID badge.
examples.vi: Nhân viên phải đeo thẻ nhận diện.

common_mistakes: He have to work → He has to work.
topics.comparison: Mustn't = bị cấm; don't have to = không cần thiết.

topics.name: Should / Ought to / Had better
topics.definition: Đưa ra lời khuyên, điều nên làm; had better thường mạnh hơn và hàm ý hậu quả nếu không làm.
topics.formula: should/ought to + V; had better + V; had better not + V.
topics.usage: Advice, recommendations, warnings.

examples.en: You should back up your files regularly.
examples.vi: Bạn nên sao lưu tệp thường xuyên.

common_mistakes: You should to rest → You should rest.
topics.comparison: Had better không có to; ought to có to.

topics.name: Possibility Modals
topics.definition: May, might, could diễn tả khả năng; must có thể diễn tả suy luận chắc chắn.
topics.formula: may/might/could + V; must + V (strong deduction); can't + V (impossibility).
topics.usage: Possibility, deduction, uncertainty.

examples.en: She might be in a meeting.
examples.vi: Có thể cô ấy đang họp.

common_mistakes: She might is busy → She might be busy.
topics.comparison: Mustn’t thường là cấm đoán, không phải phủ định của suy luận must; suy luận phủ định thường dùng can't.

topics.name: Mustn't vs Don't have to
topics.name_vi: Cấm đoán vs không cần thiết
topics.definition: Mustn't nghĩa là không được phép; don't have to nghĩa là không bắt buộc.
topics.formula: mustn't + V; don't/doesn't have to + V.
topics.usage: Prohibition versus lack of necessity.

examples.en: You mustn't share your password. You don't have to come early.
examples.vi: Bạn không được chia sẻ mật khẩu. Bạn không cần đến sớm.

common_mistakes: You don't have to park here (nếu muốn nói cấm) → You mustn't park here.
topics.comparison: Phân biệt nghĩa cấm và không cần.

topics.name: Was/Were able to vs Could
topics.definition: Could thường nói khả năng chung; was/were able to thường nhấn mạnh đã thực hiện thành công một việc cụ thể.
topics.formula: could + V; was/were able to + V.
topics.usage: Past general ability versus successful achievement on a particular occasion.

examples.en: Despite the delay, we were able to finish the project.
examples.vi: Mặc dù bị trì hoãn, chúng tôi vẫn hoàn thành được dự án.

common_mistakes: We could finish the one difficult task (không phải lúc nào cũng sai, nhưng thường kém rõ nghĩa thành công cụ thể) → were able to finish.
topics.comparison: Could dùng tự nhiên với khả năng chung hoặc động từ chỉ giác quan/nhận thức.

questions.question: I avoid _____ my phone during meetings.
questions.explanation: Avoid is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: She is interested in _____ web design.
questions.explanation: A preposition is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: _____ regularly can improve your concentration.
questions.explanation: A gerund can function as the subject.

questions.question: Would you mind _____ the window?
questions.explanation: Mind is followed by V-ing.

questions.question: They hope _____ the project by Friday.
questions.explanation: Hope is followed by to-infinitive.

questions.question: I need _____ a new password.
questions.explanation: Need + to-infinitive.

questions.question: He went to the shop _____ some milk.
questions.explanation: To-infinitive can express purpose.

questions.question: We decided _____ the earlier train.
questions.explanation: Decide is followed by to-infinitive.

questions.question: You must _____ your seat belt.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs are followed by the bare infinitive.

questions.question: The teacher made us _____ the exercise again.
questions.explanation: Make + object + bare infinitive in active voice.

questions.question: She suggested _____ a short break.
questions.explanation: Suggest is commonly followed by V-ing.

questions.question: My manager asked me _____ the figures.
questions.explanation: Ask + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: I stopped _____ some water on my way home.
questions.explanation: Stop to do means pause another activity in order to do this.

questions.question: He stopped _____ because it was unhealthy.
questions.explanation: Stop doing means quit the activity.

questions.question: When I was six, I _____ swim very well.
questions.explanation: Could expresses general ability in the past.

questions.question: After several attempts, she _____ open the locked door.
questions.explanation: Was able to emphasizes success in a specific past situation.

questions.question: _____ you help me carry this box?
questions.explanation: Could is a polite request.

questions.question: You _____ show your ID before entering the building. It is a rule.
questions.explanation: Have to expresses an external rule; subject you takes have.

questions.question: I _____ finish this today because the deadline is tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Need to + base verb expresses necessity.

questions.question: All visitors _____ sign in at reception.
questions.explanation: Plural subject visitors takes have to.

questions.question: You look exhausted. You _____ get some rest.
questions.explanation: Should + base verb gives advice.

questions.question: We _____ leave now, or we'll miss the train.
questions.explanation: Had better + base verb gives strong advice/warning.

questions.question: You _____ apologise for the mistake.
questions.explanation: Ought to is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: The lights are off. They _____ be asleep.
questions.explanation: Must + base verb expresses a strong logical deduction.

questions.question: I'm not sure, but the meeting _____ finish early.
questions.explanation: Might expresses possibility/uncertainty.

questions.question: That _____ be John's car; he is overseas.
questions.explanation: Can't expresses a strong negative deduction.

questions.question: You _____ use your phone during the exam. It is prohibited.
questions.explanation: Mustn't expresses prohibition.

questions.question: You _____ bring food; lunch is provided.
questions.explanation: Don't have to means it is not necessary.

questions.question: When she was a child, she _____ speak two languages.
questions.explanation: Could describes general past ability.

questions.question: Despite the heavy traffic, we _____ arrive before 9.
questions.explanation: Was/were able to emphasizes successful achievement on this occasion.

days.title: Nouns, Articles & Pronouns
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Countable / Uncountable Nouns
topics.name_vi: Danh từ đếm được/không đếm được
topics.definition: Danh từ đếm được có dạng số ít/số nhiều; danh từ không đếm được thường không có dạng số nhiều thông thường.
topics.formula: a/an + singular countable noun; number + plural noun; uncountable noun (no a/an).
topics.usage: Talk about quantities and noun number accurately.

examples.en: I need some information about the course.
examples.vi: Tôi cần một vài thông tin về khóa học.

common_mistakes: an advice → some advice / a piece of advice.
topics.comparison: Một số danh từ không đếm được trong tiếng Anh có thể đếm được trong ngôn ngữ khác.

topics.name: Articles: A / An / The / Zero
topics.definition: A/an giới thiệu danh từ đếm được số ít chưa xác định; the chỉ đối tượng xác định; zero article dùng trong nhiều trường hợp nói chung.
topics.formula: a + consonant sound; an + vowel sound; the + specific noun; Ø + plural/uncountable nouns in general.
topics.usage: First mention, specific reference, general statements, unique items.

examples.en: I bought a book. The book is about history.
examples.vi: Tôi mua một quyển sách. Quyển sách đó nói về lịch sử.

common_mistakes: I have a breakfast → I have breakfast.
topics.comparison: A/an dựa trên âm đầu, không chỉ chữ cái; the phụ thuộc tính xác định.

topics.name: Quantifiers
topics.definition: Much/many/a lot of/few/little diễn tả số lượng tùy danh từ đếm được hoặc không đếm được.
topics.formula: many + plural countable; much + uncountable; a lot of + both; a few + plural; a little + uncountable.
topics.usage: Ask and describe quantity.

examples.en: There isn't much time, but we have a few options.
examples.vi: Không có nhiều thời gian, nhưng chúng ta có một vài lựa chọn.

common_mistakes: much people → many people.
topics.comparison: A few/a little mang nghĩa có một ít; few/little mang nghĩa gần như không đủ.

topics.name: Some / Any / No
topics.definition: Some thường dùng trong câu khẳng định và lời mời/đề nghị; any thường dùng trong câu hỏi/phủ định; no đứng trước danh từ mang nghĩa không có.
topics.formula: some + plural/uncountable; any + plural/uncountable; no + noun.
topics.usage: Quantity, offers, questions, negatives.

examples.en: Would you like some tea?
examples.vi: Bạn có muốn uống chút trà không?

common_mistakes: I don't have no time → I don't have any time / I have no time.
topics.comparison: Any cũng có thể dùng trong câu khẳng định với nghĩa bất kỳ.

topics.name: Personal & Possessive Pronouns
topics.definition: Đại từ chủ ngữ làm chủ ngữ; đại từ tân ngữ làm tân ngữ; tính từ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ; đại từ sở hữu thay cho cụm sở hữu.
topics.formula: I/me/my/mine; he/him/his; she/her/hers; we/us/our/ours; they/them/their/theirs.
topics.usage: Avoid repeating nouns and show possession.

examples.en: This is my laptop; that one is theirs.
examples.vi: Đây là máy tính của tôi; cái kia là của họ.

common_mistakes: This is their → This is theirs (khi không có danh từ theo sau).
topics.comparison: Their + noun; theirs đứng độc lập.

topics.name: Reflexive Pronouns
topics.definition: Dùng khi chủ ngữ và tân ngữ cùng chỉ một người/vật hoặc để nhấn mạnh.
topics.formula: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
topics.usage: Reflexive meaning and emphasis.

examples.en: She taught herself to code.
examples.vi: Cô ấy tự học lập trình.

common_mistakes: She taught her → She taught herself (nếu chính cô ấy tự học).
topics.comparison: By myself có thể mang nghĩa một mình/tự mình.

topics.name: Demonstratives
topics.name_vi: Đại từ/từ hạn định chỉ định
topics.definition: This/that dùng với danh từ số ít; these/those dùng với danh từ số nhiều; this/these thường gần, that/those thường xa.
topics.formula: this + singular; that + singular; these + plural; those + plural.
topics.usage: Point to people or things by distance or context.

examples.en: These shoes are more comfortable than those.
examples.vi: Đôi giày này thoải mái hơn những đôi kia.

common_mistakes: This books → These books.
topics.comparison: Động từ và danh từ phải hòa hợp số ít/số nhiều.

topics.name: Indefinite Pronouns
topics.definition: Someone/anyone/no one, something/anything/nothing... nói về người/vật không xác định.
topics.formula: some- usually affirmative; any- questions/negatives; no- negative meaning; every- all members.
topics.usage: Refer to unspecified people, things or places.

examples.en: Nobody knows the answer.
examples.vi: Không ai biết câu trả lời.

common_mistakes: Nobody don't know → Nobody knows.
topics.comparison: Các đại từ kết thúc bằng -one/-body/-thing thường đi với động từ số ít.

questions.question: How _____ pieces of advice did he give you?
questions.explanation: Pieces is a plural countable noun.

questions.question: There isn't _____ information on the website.
questions.explanation: Information is uncountable.

questions.question: We bought two _____ of bread.
questions.explanation: Loaf has the plural loaves; bread is uncountable.

questions.question: The furniture _____ very expensive.
questions.explanation: Furniture is an uncountable singular noun.

questions.topic: Articles: A / An / The / Zero Article
questions.question: She is _____ honest person.
questions.explanation: Honest begins with a vowel sound.

questions.topic: Articles: A / An / The / Zero Article
questions.question: I usually have _____ breakfast at 7.
questions.explanation: Meals are often used without an article when speaking generally.

questions.topic: Articles: A / An / The / Zero Article
questions.question: Can you close _____ window next to you?
questions.explanation: The identifies a specific, known window.

questions.topic: Articles: A / An / The / Zero Article
questions.question: He wants to become _____ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound.

questions.topic: Articles: A / An / The / Zero Article
questions.question: _____ children need enough sleep.
questions.explanation: Plural countable nouns take zero article for general statements.

questions.topic: Much / Many / A lot of / Few / Little
questions.question: How _____ students are in your class?
questions.explanation: Students is plural countable.

questions.topic: Much / Many / A lot of / Few / Little
questions.question: We have very _____ time, so let's start now.
questions.explanation: Time is uncountable; little means not much.

questions.topic: Much / Many / A lot of / Few / Little
questions.question: There are _____ chairs left, so everyone can sit down.
questions.explanation: A few means some, enough to be useful.

questions.topic: Much / Many / A lot of / Few / Little
questions.question: She doesn't drink _____ water during the day.
questions.explanation: Water is uncountable.

questions.topic: Much / Many / A lot of / Few / Little
questions.question: I have _____ work to do this afternoon.
questions.explanation: A lot of works with uncountable work.

questions.question: Would you like _____ coffee?
questions.explanation: Some is common in offers.

questions.question: There aren't _____ clean cups.
questions.explanation: Any is used in negative sentences.

questions.question: We have _____ reason to worry; everything is ready.
questions.explanation: No + noun means not any.

questions.question: This message is for Sarah and _____.
questions.explanation: Object pronoun me follows the preposition for.

questions.question: That isn't our car. _____ is blue.
questions.explanation: Ours is a possessive pronoun used without a noun.

questions.question: Tom and Anna said _____ would join us later.
questions.explanation: They is the subject pronoun.

questions.question: This message is for Sarah and _____.
questions.explanation: Object pronoun me follows the preposition for.

questions.question: He cut _____ while preparing dinner.
questions.explanation: The subject and object refer to the same person.

questions.question: I completed the whole task by _____.
questions.explanation: By myself means alone/without help.

questions.question: _____ books over there belong to the library.
questions.explanation: Those refers to plural things at a distance.

questions.question: I like _____ jacket I'm wearing.
questions.explanation: This refers to one nearby item.

questions.question: _____ has left a bag at reception. We don't know who.
questions.explanation: Someone is used for an unspecified person in an affirmative statement.

questions.question: I looked everywhere, but I couldn't find _____.
questions.explanation: Anything is common in negative clauses.

questions.question: _____ in the office knows how to use this printer.
questions.explanation: Everyone takes a singular verb and means all people.

questions.question: There is _____ in the fridge; it is completely empty.
questions.explanation: Nothing means not anything.

questions.question: Did _____ call while I was out?
questions.explanation: Anyone is common in questions.

days.title: Adjectives, Adverbs & Comparison
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Adjectives
topics.definition: Tính từ mô tả đặc điểm của danh từ hoặc đại từ; thường đứng trước danh từ hoặc sau linking verbs.
topics.formula: adjective + noun; subject + linking verb + adjective.
topics.usage: Describe people, things, feelings and states.

examples.en: The new application is useful.
examples.vi: Ứng dụng mới rất hữu ích.

common_mistakes: She looks beautifully → She looks beautiful.
topics.comparison: Sau be, seem, look, feel, become thường dùng adjective khi mô tả chủ ngữ.

topics.name: Adverbs
topics.definition: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ, tính từ, trạng từ khác hoặc cả câu.
topics.formula: verb + adverb; adverb + adjective; adverb + adverb.
topics.usage: Describe how, when, where, how often or to what degree.

examples.en: He explained the problem clearly.
examples.vi: Anh ấy giải thích vấn đề một cách rõ ràng.

common_mistakes: He speaks clear → He speaks clearly.
topics.comparison: Không phải mọi trạng từ đều có -ly; fast, hard, well là các dạng đặc biệt.

topics.name: Adjective vs Adverb
topics.definition: Chọn tính từ để mô tả danh từ/chủ ngữ; chọn trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho hành động.
topics.formula: adjective + noun / linking verb + adjective; action verb + adverb.
topics.usage: Distinguish description of a person/thing from manner of action.

examples.en: She is a careful driver and drives carefully.
examples.vi: Cô ấy là người lái xe cẩn thận và lái xe một cách cẩn thận.

common_mistakes: She sings beautiful → She sings beautifully.
topics.comparison: Good thường là adjective; well thường là adverb, nhưng well cũng có thể là adjective nghĩa khỏe.

topics.name: Comparatives
topics.definition: So sánh hai người/vật/sự việc.
topics.formula: short adjective + -er + than; more + long adjective + than; irregular forms.
topics.usage: Compare two items.

examples.en: This route is shorter than the other one.
examples.vi: Tuyến đường này ngắn hơn tuyến đường kia.

common_mistakes: more easier → easier.
topics.comparison: Chú ý gấp đôi phụ âm, bỏ -y thành -ier và dạng bất quy tắc.

topics.name: Superlatives
topics.definition: Diễn tả mức cao nhất/thấp nhất trong một nhóm.
topics.formula: the + adjective-est; the most + long adjective; irregular forms.
topics.usage: Identify the top or bottom degree in a group.

examples.en: It is the most expensive phone in the shop.
examples.vi: Đó là chiếc điện thoại đắt nhất cửa hàng.

common_mistakes: the most fastest → the fastest.
topics.comparison: Thường dùng the trước so sánh nhất; cần nêu nhóm so sánh phù hợp.

topics.name: As ... as
topics.definition: Diễn tả hai đối tượng ngang bằng hoặc không ngang bằng về một đặc điểm.
topics.formula: as + adjective/adverb + as; not as/so + adjective/adverb + as.
topics.usage: Compare equality or lack of equality.

examples.en: My laptop is as fast as yours.
examples.vi: Máy tính của tôi nhanh bằng máy tính của bạn.

common_mistakes: as taller as → as tall as.
topics.comparison: Không dùng dạng so sánh hơn trong cấu trúc as...as.

topics.name: Too / Enough
topics.definition: Too diễn tả vượt quá mức cần thiết; enough diễn tả đủ mức cần thiết.
topics.formula: too + adjective/adverb; adjective/adverb + enough; enough + noun; too much/many + noun.
topics.usage: Explain excess or sufficiency.

examples.en: The room is too small for ten people.
examples.vi: Căn phòng quá nhỏ cho mười người.

common_mistakes: enough strong → strong enough.
topics.comparison: Enough đứng trước danh từ nhưng sau adjective/adverb.

topics.name: So / Such
topics.definition: So nhấn mạnh tính từ/trạng từ; such nhấn mạnh cụm danh từ.
topics.formula: so + adjective/adverb + that; such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that.
topics.usage: Show a result caused by an extreme degree.

examples.en: It was such a difficult task that we needed help.
examples.vi: Đó là một nhiệm vụ khó đến mức chúng tôi cần giúp đỡ.

common_mistakes: so a difficult task → such a difficult task.
topics.comparison: So + adjective; such + noun phrase.

topics.name: -ed / -ing Adjectives
topics.definition: -ed thường mô tả cảm xúc của người; -ing mô tả điều/người gây ra cảm xúc.
topics.formula: person + be + -ed; thing/person causing feeling + be + -ing.
topics.usage: Describe feelings versus the cause of feelings.

examples.en: I am interested in the interesting course.
examples.vi: Tôi hứng thú với khóa học thú vị đó.

common_mistakes: The lesson was bored → The lesson was boring.
topics.comparison: Người cảm thấy -ed; sự vật gây cảm giác thường dùng -ing.

questions.question: We need a _____ solution to this problem.
questions.explanation: An adjective modifies the noun solution.

questions.question: The soup smells _____.
questions.explanation: Smell is a linking verb here; use an adjective.

questions.question: She bought a _____ bag for work.
questions.explanation: Adjectives generally precede the noun; colour commonly comes before material.

questions.question: Please drive _____. The road is wet.
questions.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb drive.

questions.question: He _____ forgets his keys; it happens almost every day.
questions.explanation: Often is an adverb of frequency.

questions.question: The team worked _____ to meet the deadline.
questions.explanation: Hard means with effort; hardly means almost not.

questions.question: She speaks English very _____.
questions.explanation: Well is the adverb modifying speaks.

questions.question: The children looked _____ after the long trip.
questions.explanation: Look is a linking verb; use adjective tired.

questions.question: He is a _____ driver, and he drives _____.
questions.explanation: Careful modifies driver; carefully modifies drives.

questions.question: The new software works _____.
questions.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb works.

questions.question: This exercise is _____ than the previous one.
questions.explanation: Short adjective ending in consonant + y changes y to ier.

questions.question: A train is usually _____ than a bus for this journey.
questions.explanation: Use adjective + -er for this short adjective.

questions.question: The new version is _____ useful than the old one.
questions.explanation: Use more + long adjective + than.

questions.question: My commute is _____ than it was last year.
questions.explanation: Bad has the irregular comparative worse.

questions.question: That was the _____ meal I've had this year.
questions.explanation: Good has the irregular superlative best.

questions.question: This is _____ building in the area.
questions.explanation: Use the + -est for a short adjective.

questions.question: It is one of _____ useful apps on my phone.
questions.explanation: One of the + superlative + plural noun.

questions.question: My sister is _____ tall _____ I am.
questions.explanation: Equality uses as + adjective + as.

questions.question: This route is not _____ expensive _____ the highway.
questions.explanation: Not as + adjective + as expresses a lower degree.

questions.question: He can run as _____ as his brother.
questions.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb run.

questions.question: The coffee is _____ hot to drink now.
questions.explanation: Too + adjective + to-infinitive indicates excess.

questions.question: She isn't old _____ to drive.
questions.explanation: Adjective + enough.

questions.question: We don't have _____ chairs for everyone.
questions.explanation: Enough + plural noun.

questions.question: The bag is _____ heavy for me to carry.
questions.explanation: Too + adjective + for someone + to V.

questions.question: It was _____ cold that we stayed inside.
questions.explanation: So + adjective + that.

questions.question: They are _____ friendly people that everyone likes them.
questions.explanation: Such + adjective + plural noun + that.

questions.question: It was _____ an interesting talk that I took notes.
questions.explanation: Such + a/an + adjective + singular noun + that.

questions.question: I was _____ by the documentary.
questions.explanation: Interested describes the person's feeling.

questions.question: The documentary was very _____.
questions.explanation: Interesting describes what causes the feeling.

questions.question: The long journey was _____.
questions.explanation: Tiring describes something that causes tiredness.

days.title: Passive Voice & Reported Speech
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Passive Present Simple
topics.definition: Dùng khi người/vật chịu tác động quan trọng hơn người thực hiện.
topics.formula: am/is/are + V3/ed.
topics.usage: General processes, routines, facts where the doer is unknown/unimportant.

examples.en: These products are made in Vietnam.
examples.vi: Những sản phẩm này được sản xuất tại Việt Nam.

common_mistakes: The products make in Vietnam → are made.
topics.comparison: Chủ ngữ mới phải hòa hợp với am/is/are.

topics.name: Passive Past Simple
topics.definition: Diễn tả hành động bị tác động đã hoàn tất trong quá khứ.
topics.formula: was/were + V3/ed.
topics.usage: Completed past actions with focus on receiver/result.

examples.en: The bridge was built in 2010.
examples.vi: Cây cầu được xây dựng vào năm 2010.

common_mistakes: The bridge built in 2010 → was built.
topics.comparison: Dùng was/were theo chủ ngữ; động từ ở V3.

topics.name: Passive Present Perfect
topics.name_vi: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành
topics.definition: Nhấn mạnh kết quả hiện tại của hành động đã được thực hiện.
topics.formula: have/has been + V3/ed.
topics.usage: Completed action with present relevance; doer unknown/unimportant.

examples.en: The report has been sent to the manager.
examples.vi: Báo cáo đã được gửi cho quản lý.

common_mistakes: The report has sent → has been sent.
topics.comparison: Không bỏ been trong cấu trúc bị động hoàn thành.

topics.name: Passive Future
topics.definition: Diễn tả việc sẽ được thực hiện trong tương lai.
topics.formula: will be + V3/ed; am/is/are going to be + V3/ed.
topics.usage: Future actions where receiver is the focus.

examples.en: The results will be announced tomorrow.
examples.vi: Kết quả sẽ được công bố vào ngày mai.

common_mistakes: The results will announced → will be announced.
topics.comparison: Sau will be dùng V3.

topics.name: Passive with Modals
topics.name_vi: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu
topics.definition: Diễn tả nghĩa vụ/khả năng/khuyên bảo mà chủ ngữ nhận tác động.
topics.formula: modal + be + V3/ed.
topics.usage: Rules, advice, possibility in passive form.

examples.en: Passwords must be changed regularly.
examples.vi: Mật khẩu phải được thay đổi thường xuyên.

common_mistakes: must changed → must be changed.
topics.comparison: Sau modal dùng be + V3.

topics.name: Active vs Passive
topics.definition: Chủ động nhấn người thực hiện; bị động nhấn người/vật chịu tác động.
topics.formula: Active: S + V + O; Passive: O + be + V3 (+ by + agent).
topics.usage: Choose focus based on context; omit by-agent if unknown/unimportant.

examples.en: The team fixed the bug. The bug was fixed by the team.
examples.vi: Nhóm đã sửa lỗi. Lỗi đã được nhóm sửa.

common_mistakes: The bug fixed by team → The bug was fixed by the team.
topics.comparison: Chỉ chuyển sang bị động khi động từ có tân ngữ phù hợp.

topics.name: Reported Statements
topics.name_vi: Câu tường thuật dạng câu kể
topics.definition: Tường thuật lại lời nói; thường lùi thì khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ và ngữ cảnh yêu cầu.
topics.formula: said (that) + clause; told + object + (that) + clause.
topics.usage: Report statements and information.

examples.en: She said that she was busy.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nói rằng cô ấy đang bận.

common_mistakes: She said me → She told me / She said to me.
topics.comparison: Lùi thì không phải lúc nào cũng bắt buộc nếu sự thật vẫn đúng hoặc ngữ cảnh không yêu cầu.

topics.name: Reported Questions
topics.name_vi: Câu tường thuật dạng câu hỏi
topics.definition: Tường thuật câu hỏi bằng trật tự câu khẳng định, không đảo trợ động từ.
topics.formula: asked + if/whether + subject + verb; asked + wh-word + subject + verb.
topics.usage: Report yes/no and wh-questions.

examples.en: He asked me where I lived.
examples.vi: Anh ấy hỏi tôi sống ở đâu.

common_mistakes: He asked where did I live → where I lived.
topics.comparison: Không dùng dấu hỏi/đảo ngữ trong mệnh đề tường thuật.

topics.name: Say vs Tell
topics.definition: Say thường không cần tân ngữ chỉ người ngay sau; tell thường cần người nghe.
topics.formula: say + (that) clause; say something to someone; tell + someone + (that) clause.
topics.usage: Report speech with correct object pattern.

examples.en: He told me that the meeting was cancelled.
examples.vi: Anh ấy nói với tôi cuộc họp đã bị hủy.

common_mistakes: He told that... → He said that... / He told me that...
topics.comparison: Tell someone; say something (to someone).

topics.name: Time / Place Changes
topics.definition: Đổi đại từ, trạng từ thời gian/nơi chốn theo góc nhìn và thời điểm tường thuật.
topics.formula: now→then; today→that day; tomorrow→the next day; here→there; this→that (when context requires).
topics.usage: Adjust references when reporting from a different time/place.

examples.en: She said, “I will come tomorrow.” → She said she would come the next day.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nói: “Ngày mai tôi sẽ đến.” → Cô ấy nói rằng hôm sau cô ấy sẽ đến.

common_mistakes: Giữ tomorrow khi thời điểm tường thuật vẫn là hôm trước ngày mai.
topics.comparison: Thay đổi phụ thuộc ngữ cảnh, không đổi máy móc.

topics.name: Reported Commands
topics.definition: Tường thuật yêu cầu/mệnh lệnh bằng tell/ask + object + (not) to-infinitive.
topics.formula: told/asked + object + (not) to + V.
topics.usage: Report instructions, requests and prohibitions.

examples.en: The teacher told us to open our books.
examples.vi: Giáo viên bảo chúng tôi mở sách.

common_mistakes: The teacher told us open → told us to open.
topics.comparison: Mệnh lệnh phủ định dùng not to V.

questions.question: Coffee _____ in many countries.
questions.explanation: Present Simple passive: am/is/are + V3.

questions.question: These emails _____ every morning.
questions.explanation: Plural subject takes are + V3.

questions.question: English _____ in many international companies.
questions.explanation: The language receives the action: is used.

questions.question: The new library _____ in 2018.
questions.explanation: Past Simple passive: was/were + V3.

questions.question: The invitations _____ last week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject + were + V3.

questions.question: My laptop _____ yesterday.
questions.explanation: A completed past action uses was + V3.

questions.question: The documents _____ already _____.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect passive: have/has been + V3.

questions.question: The website _____ recently _____.
questions.explanation: Website is singular: has been + V3.

questions.question: The winner _____ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive: will be + V3.

questions.question: The new rules _____ next month.
questions.explanation: Will be + V3 forms the future passive.

questions.question: All applications must _____ by Friday.
questions.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + V3.

questions.question: This tool can _____ for data analysis.
questions.explanation: Can be + V3.

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: “The team checks the code.”

options.B: The code is checked by the team.
options.D: The team is checked by the code.

questions.explanation: Object becomes subject; use is + V3.

questions.question: Which sentence focuses on the person doing the action?
questions.explanation: The active sentence names the doer as subject.

questions.question: “I am tired,” she said. → She said that she _____ tired.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, am commonly backshifts to was.

questions.question: “We have finished,” they said. → They said they _____ finished.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect commonly backshifts to Past Perfect.

questions.question: “I will call you,” he said. → He said he _____ call me.
questions.explanation: Will commonly changes to would.

questions.question: “I work here,” Tom said. → Tom said that he _____ there.
questions.explanation: Present Simple commonly backshifts to Past Simple; here changes to there when needed.

questions.question: “Where do you live?” she asked me. → She asked me where I _____.
questions.explanation: Reported wh-question uses statement word order.

questions.question: “Are you busy?” he asked. → He asked _____ I was busy.
questions.explanation: Yes/no reported questions use if or whether.

questions.question: “What time does the train leave?” → He asked what time the train _____.
questions.explanation: Backshift and statement word order: the train left.

questions.question: “Did you call me?” she asked. → She asked whether I _____ her.
questions.explanation: Past Simple commonly backshifts to Past Perfect.

questions.question: He _____ me that the shop was closed.
questions.explanation: Tell is followed by an object: told me.

questions.question: She _____ that she was ready.
questions.explanation: Say can be followed by a that-clause without an object.

questions.question: He said _____ me that he was sorry.
questions.explanation: Say to someone is possible; tell someone does not take to.

questions.question: “I will finish this tomorrow,” she said. → She said she would finish it _____.
questions.explanation: Tomorrow commonly changes to the next day.

questions.question: “I live here,” he said. → He said he lived _____.
questions.explanation: Here commonly changes to there when the viewpoint changes.

questions.question: “I saw her yesterday,” he said. → He said he had seen her _____.
questions.explanation: Yesterday commonly changes to the previous day/the day before.

questions.question: “Close the door,” the teacher said to us. → The teacher told us _____ the door.
questions.explanation: Tell + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: “Don't touch the screen,” she said. → She told me _____ the screen.
questions.explanation: Negative reported command: told + object + not to V.

days.title: Conditionals & Relative Clauses
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Zero Conditional
topics.definition: Diễn tả sự thật, quy luật hoặc kết quả luôn đúng khi điều kiện xảy ra.
topics.formula: If + Present Simple, Present Simple.
topics.usage: Facts, rules, general truths.

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.vi: Nếu bạn làm nóng đá, nó tan chảy.

common_mistakes: If you will heat ice → If you heat ice.
topics.comparison: Hai mệnh đề thường dùng hiện tại đơn.

topics.name: First Conditional
topics.definition: Diễn tả tình huống tương lai có khả năng xảy ra và kết quả có thể xảy ra.
topics.formula: If + Present Simple, will + V.
topics.usage: Realistic future possibility and likely result.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.vi: Nếu trời mưa, chúng tôi sẽ ở nhà.

common_mistakes: If it will rain → If it rains.
topics.comparison: Không dùng will trong mệnh đề if thông thường.

topics.name: Second Conditional
topics.definition: Diễn tả tình huống giả định/không có thật hoặc ít có khả năng ở hiện tại/tương lai.
topics.formula: If + Past Simple, would + V.
topics.usage: Unreal or unlikely present/future situations; imaginary advice.

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn another language.
examples.vi: Nếu có nhiều thời gian hơn, tôi sẽ học thêm một ngôn ngữ.

common_mistakes: If I would have time → If I had time.
topics.comparison: Were thường dùng với mọi chủ ngữ trong giả định trang trọng: If I were you.

topics.name: Unless
topics.definition: Unless diễn tả điều kiện phủ định, tương đương if...not trong nhiều trường hợp.
topics.formula: Unless + affirmative clause, main clause; = If + negative clause.
topics.usage: State a condition that must be met to avoid a result.

examples.en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
examples.vi: Nếu bạn không nhanh lên, bạn sẽ lỡ xe buýt.

common_mistakes: Unless you don't hurry → Unless you hurry.
topics.comparison: Tránh phủ định kép; không dùng unless với nghĩa nếu không mà lại thêm not.

topics.name: When / As soon as
topics.name_vi: Mệnh đề thời gian tương lai
topics.definition: Trong mệnh đề thời gian nói về tương lai, dùng hiện tại đơn thay vì will theo quy tắc thông thường.
topics.formula: When/As soon as + Present Simple, will + V.
topics.usage: Future events linked by time sequence.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ gọi bạn ngay khi tôi đến.

common_mistakes: as soon as I will arrive → as soon as I arrive.
topics.comparison: Will nằm ở mệnh đề chính, không nằm trong mệnh đề thời gian.

topics.name: Relative Pronouns
topics.definition: Who, which, that, whose nối mệnh đề bổ nghĩa cho danh từ.
topics.formula: person: who/that; thing: which/that; possession: whose.
topics.usage: Identify or add information about a person or thing.

examples.en: The woman who works here is my aunt.
examples.vi: Người phụ nữ làm việc ở đây là dì tôi.

common_mistakes: The woman which works here → who works here.
topics.comparison: That không dùng trong non-defining relative clauses.

topics.name: Relative Adverbs
topics.definition: Where, when, why nối mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn, thời gian, lý do.
topics.formula: place + where; time + when; reason + why.
topics.usage: Give place, time or reason information.

examples.en: This is the café where we first met.
examples.vi: Đây là quán cà phê nơi chúng tôi gặp nhau lần đầu.

common_mistakes: the café which we met → the café where we met / which we visited.
topics.comparison: Where thay cho at/in which tùy cấu trúc; không dùng where nếu thiếu quan hệ địa điểm phù hợp.

topics.name: Defining Relative Clauses
topics.name_vi: Mệnh đề quan hệ xác định
topics.definition: Cung cấp thông tin thiết yếu để xác định danh từ; không dùng dấu phẩy.
topics.formula: noun + who/which/that/whose/where + clause.
topics.usage: Identify exactly which person or thing is meant.

examples.en: The files that you sent are useful.
examples.vi: Những tệp mà bạn gửi rất hữu ích.

common_mistakes: The files, that you sent, → bỏ dấu phẩy trong defining clause.
topics.comparison: Có thể lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ làm tân ngữ trong defining clause.

topics.name: Non-defining Relative Clauses
topics.name_vi: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định
topics.definition: Bổ sung thông tin thêm; danh từ đã xác định; dùng dấu phẩy và không dùng that.
topics.formula: noun, who/which/whose/where + clause,
topics.usage: Add extra, non-essential information.

examples.en: My laptop, which I bought last year, is still working well.
examples.vi: Máy tính của tôi, chiếc mà tôi mua năm ngoái, vẫn hoạt động tốt.

common_mistakes: My laptop, that I bought... → which I bought...
topics.comparison: Không dùng that; không lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ trong mệnh đề này.

questions.question: If you heat water to 100°C at sea level, it _____.
questions.explanation: Zero conditional uses present simple in both clauses.

questions.question: If people don't sleep enough, they often _____ tired.
questions.explanation: General result: present simple.

questions.question: Plants die if they _____ enough water.
questions.explanation: If-clause in zero conditional uses present simple.

questions.question: If it _____ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
questions.explanation: If + Present Simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: I'll send you the file when I _____ back at my desk.
questions.explanation: Future time clause uses present simple.

questions.question: If you study regularly, you _____ your results.
questions.explanation: Main clause of first conditional uses will + V.

questions.question: Unless we leave now, we _____ the bus.
questions.explanation: Unless means if not; likely future result uses will.

questions.question: If I _____ more confident, I would speak more in meetings.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + V.

questions.question: If she had a car, she _____ to work.
questions.explanation: Would + base verb gives the hypothetical result.

questions.question: If I were you, I _____ the instructions again.
questions.explanation: If I were you is a common hypothetical advice pattern.

questions.question: They would travel more if they _____ more money.
questions.explanation: If-clause takes past simple.

questions.question: You won't pass _____ you study.
questions.explanation: Unless you study = if you do not study.

questions.question: Unless he _____ now, he'll be late.
questions.explanation: Unless-clause uses present simple for a future condition.

questions.question: We can't start _____ everyone is here.
questions.explanation: Unless means except if/if not; here start only if everyone is here.

questions.question: I'll text you as soon as I _____.
questions.explanation: Use present simple in future time clauses.

questions.question: When the meeting _____, we'll discuss the budget.
questions.explanation: When-clause referring to future uses present simple.

questions.question: The man _____ helped me was very kind.
questions.explanation: Who refers to a person as subject.

questions.question: The laptop _____ I bought is already slow.
questions.explanation: Which refers to a thing.

questions.question: That's the woman _____ son is in my class.
questions.explanation: Whose shows possession.

questions.question: Is this the book _____ you recommended?
questions.explanation: That can refer to a thing in a defining relative clause.

questions.question: The company _____ office is near the station is hiring.
questions.explanation: Whose can show possession for organisations/things.

questions.question: This is the town _____ my father grew up.
questions.explanation: Where refers to a place.

questions.question: I remember the day _____ we first met.
questions.explanation: When refers to a time.

questions.question: Do you know the reason _____ she left early?
questions.explanation: Why refers to a reason.

questions.question: Employees _____ arrive late must inform their manager.
questions.explanation: Who refers to people in a defining clause.

questions.question: The app _____ we use at work is easy to learn.
questions.explanation: That can refer to a thing in a defining clause.

questions.question: The person _____ you called is my supervisor.
questions.explanation: Who can be the object of a defining relative clause.

questions.question: My brother, _____ lives in Hanoi, is visiting us.
questions.explanation: Non-defining clause about a person uses who; not that.

questions.question: The office, _____ was renovated last year, looks modern.
questions.explanation: Which is used for things in non-defining clauses.

questions.question: Ms Lee, _____ team won the award, thanked everyone.
questions.explanation: Whose shows possession; non-defining clause is set off by commas.

days.title: Prepositions & Sentence Structures
objectives: Hiểu cấu trúc và cách dùng
Nhận biết lỗi thường gặp
Vận dụng trong ngữ cảnh A2–B1

topics.name: Prepositions of Time: In / On / At
topics.definition: In dùng với khoảng thời gian rộng; on với ngày/ngày cụ thể; at với giờ và một số thời điểm cố định.
topics.formula: in + months/years/seasons/parts of day; on + days/dates; at + clock times.
topics.usage: Locate events in time.

examples.en: The meeting starts at 9 a.m. on Monday.
examples.vi: Cuộc họp bắt đầu lúc 9 giờ sáng thứ Hai.

common_mistakes: at Monday → on Monday.
topics.comparison: Một số cụm cố định: at night, in the morning, on Monday morning.

topics.name: Prepositions of Place
topics.definition: Giới từ chỉ vị trí tương đối giữa người/vật và địa điểm.
topics.formula: in (inside/area); on (surface); at (point/location); under, above, between, next to.
topics.usage: Describe where something is.

examples.en: The keys are on the table.
examples.vi: Chìa khóa ở trên bàn.

common_mistakes: The keys are in the table (nếu không ở bên trong ngăn bàn) → on the table.
topics.comparison: In nhấn bên trong/khu vực; at nhấn điểm/địa điểm.

topics.name: Prepositions of Movement
topics.definition: Diễn tả hướng hoặc đường di chuyển.
topics.formula: to (destination); into (enter); across (from one side to another); through (inside and out).
topics.usage: Describe movement and routes.

examples.en: We walked through the tunnel.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đi bộ xuyên qua đường hầm.

common_mistakes: walked across the tunnel (nếu ý là đi bên trong) → through the tunnel.
topics.comparison: Across nhấn băng qua bề mặt/khoảng; through nhấn đi bên trong.

topics.name: For / Since / During / While
topics.definition: For chỉ khoảng thời gian; since chỉ mốc bắt đầu; during + danh từ; while + mệnh đề.
topics.formula: for + duration; since + starting point; during + noun; while + subject + verb.
topics.usage: Describe duration, starting point and simultaneous events.

examples.en: I've lived here for three years.
examples.vi: Tôi đã sống ở đây được ba năm.

common_mistakes: since three years → for three years.
topics.comparison: Since + mốc; for + khoảng; during + noun phrase; while + clause.

topics.name: Conjunctions
topics.definition: Nối từ, cụm từ hoặc mệnh đề để thể hiện quan hệ ý nghĩa.
topics.formula: and (addition); but (contrast); or (choice); so (result); because (reason).
topics.usage: Connect ideas logically.

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
examples.vi: Tôi mệt nên đã đi ngủ sớm.

common_mistakes: Because I was tired, so I slept → Because I was tired, I slept / I was tired, so I slept.
topics.comparison: Không dùng because và so cùng để nối cùng một quan hệ nguyên nhân-kết quả trong cấu trúc cơ bản.

topics.name: Although / Despite / However
topics.definition: Although nối mệnh đề; despite đi với danh từ/V-ing; however là trạng từ liên kết câu.
topics.formula: although + clause; despite + noun/V-ing; despite the fact that + clause; sentence. However, sentence.
topics.usage: Show contrast or unexpected result.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
examples.vi: Mặc dù trời mưa, chúng tôi vẫn ra ngoài.

common_mistakes: Despite it was raining → Despite the rain / Despite the fact that it was raining.
topics.comparison: However thường cần dấu câu phù hợp; despite không trực tiếp đi với mệnh đề đầy đủ.

topics.name: Too / Either / So / Neither
topics.definition: So/neither dùng đảo trợ động từ với chủ ngữ mới; too/either thường đặt cuối câu.
topics.formula: So + auxiliary/be/modal + subject; Neither + auxiliary/be/modal + subject; too (affirmative); either (negative).
topics.usage: Agree with positive or negative statements.

examples.en: I don't like spicy food. Neither do I.
examples.vi: Tôi không thích đồ ăn cay. Tôi cũng vậy.

common_mistakes: Neither I do → Neither do I.
topics.comparison: Chọn trợ động từ phù hợp với thì/động từ của câu trước.

topics.name: Question Tags
topics.definition: Câu hỏi ngắn cuối câu để xác nhận thông tin hoặc tìm sự đồng tình.
topics.formula: positive statement + negative tag; negative statement + positive tag.
topics.usage: Check information and invite confirmation.

examples.en: You work here, don't you?
examples.vi: Bạn làm việc ở đây, phải không?

common_mistakes: You are tired, are you? → You are tired, aren't you?
topics.comparison: Đại từ trong tag phải thay chủ ngữ; trợ động từ phải phù hợp.

topics.name: Wish
topics.definition: Wish + Past Simple diễn tả mong muốn trái với hiện tại.
topics.formula: S + wish(es) + subject + Past Simple; were có thể dùng cho mọi chủ ngữ trong văn phong trang trọng.
topics.usage: Express unreal present wishes or dissatisfaction.

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.vi: Tôi ước mình có nhiều thời gian rảnh hơn.

common_mistakes: I wish I have more time → I wish I had more time.
topics.comparison: Wish + past simple nói hiện tại; wish + past perfect nói tiếc nuối quá khứ.

topics.name: Sentence Transformation
topics.definition: Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa bằng cấu trúc tương đương, không thay đổi thông tin cốt lõi.
topics.formula: Common patterns: because ↔ because of; although ↔ despite; too ↔ not ... enough; active ↔ passive; if ... not ↔ unless.
topics.usage: Rephrase accurately using target grammar.

examples.en: The box is too heavy for me to lift. → The box isn't light enough for me to lift.
examples.vi: Cái hộp quá nặng để tôi nhấc. → Cái hộp không đủ nhẹ để tôi nhấc.

common_mistakes: Thay cấu trúc nhưng làm thay đổi mức độ hoặc chủ thể.
topics.comparison: Kiểm tra nghĩa, thì, chủ ngữ, phủ định và cấu trúc đi kèm.

questions.topic: Prepositions of Time: In / On / At
questions.question: The conference starts _____ 8:30 a.m.
questions.explanation: At is used with clock times.

questions.topic: Prepositions of Time: In / On / At
questions.question: My birthday is _____ November.
questions.explanation: In is used with months.

questions.topic: Prepositions of Time: In / On / At
questions.question: We have English class _____ Sunday.
questions.explanation: On is used with days.

questions.topic: Prepositions of Time: In / On / At
questions.question: I usually read _____ the evening.
questions.explanation: In the evening is the usual expression.

questions.question: The children are playing _____ the garden.
questions.explanation: In indicates inside an area.

questions.question: There is a picture _____ the wall.
questions.explanation: On is used for a surface.

questions.question: The bank is _____ the supermarket and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two items.

questions.question: The cat jumped _____ the box.
questions.explanation: Into expresses movement from outside to inside.

questions.question: We walked _____ the road to reach the park.
questions.explanation: Across means from one side to the other.

questions.question: I've worked here _____ 2023.
questions.explanation: Since is followed by a starting point.

questions.question: We waited _____ two hours.
questions.explanation: For is followed by a duration.

questions.question: I fell asleep _____ the film.
questions.explanation: During is followed by a noun phrase.

questions.question: I listened to music while I _____ dinner.
questions.explanation: While is followed by a clause; Past Continuous shows an ongoing past action.

questions.question: I wanted to go out, _____ it was raining heavily.
questions.explanation: But connects contrasting ideas.

questions.question: You can take the bus _____ walk to the station.
questions.explanation: Or presents a choice.

questions.question: She was ill, _____ she stayed at home.
questions.explanation: So introduces a result.

questions.question: _____ the traffic was heavy, we arrived on time.
questions.explanation: Although is followed by a clause.

questions.question: Despite _____ tired, he finished the report.
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a noun or V-ing.

questions.question: It was expensive. _____, I decided to buy it.
questions.explanation: However links contrasting sentences.

questions.question: _____ the rain, the match continued.
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a noun phrase.

questions.question: “I love classical music.” “_____.”
questions.explanation: Positive agreement with a normal verb: So + do + subject.

questions.question: “I can't swim.” “_____.”
questions.explanation: Negative agreement repeats the modal: Neither + can + subject.

questions.question: “I'm tired.” “_____.”
questions.explanation: BE in the original statement is repeated in the inversion.

questions.question: You have finished the task, _____?
questions.explanation: Positive present perfect statement takes negative tag have you.

questions.question: She isn't coming, _____?
questions.explanation: Negative statement takes positive tag.

questions.question: They went home early, _____?
questions.explanation: Past Simple went takes did in the tag.

questions.question: I wish I _____ more free time.
questions.explanation: Wish + past simple expresses an unreal present wish.

questions.question: He wishes he _____ closer to his office.
questions.explanation: Wish + past simple refers to an unreal present situation.

questions.question: "Because it was raining, we stayed inside." Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

options.A: Because of the rain, we stayed inside.
options.B: Despite the rain, we stayed inside.
options.C: Although the rain, we stayed inside.
options.D: However the rain, we stayed inside.

questions.explanation: Because + clause can become because of + noun phrase. Both sentences express the same reason and result.

questions.question: “You must not park here.” Choose the closest equivalent.

options.A: You don't have to park here.
options.B: You are allowed to park here.
options.C: You are not allowed to park here.

questions.explanation: Must not expresses prohibition; not allowed to preserves the meaning.
